```{=html}
<style>
.w015 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w015 .w015-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w015 .w015-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w015 .w015-q { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w015 .w015-in {
  flex: 0 0 130px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  font-weight: 600; min-width: 0;
}
.w015 .w015-in.w015-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w015 .w015-in.w015-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w015 .w015-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w015 button.w015-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w015 .w015-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w015 .w015-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w015 .w015-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w015 .w015-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w015 .w015-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w015 iw" id="w015">
  <div class="w015-rows" aria-label="fill in the missing term"></div>
  <div class="w015-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w015-btn w015-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w015-btn w015-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w015-btn w015-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w015-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w015-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w015-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    A threat is a potential cause of an incident, risk is the weight of a threat expressed as likelihood × impact, and a control is a measure that reduces a risk. The chain runs in exactly that order: name the threat, judge its likelihood and impact, and only then choose a control. See <a href="#def-trc">the definition of threat, risk and control</a> in <a href="#sec-01-threat-risk-control">the section on threat, risk and control</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w015');
  const rowsBox = root.querySelector('.w015-rows');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w015-msg');
  // [question, accepted answers (normalised), canonical answer to show]
  const QUESTIONS = [
    ['A potential cause of an incident - something that could happen to the detriment of confidentiality, integrity or availability - is called a …',
      ['threat'], 'threat'],
    ['The weight of such a cause, expressed as likelihood × impact, is called the …',
      ['risk'], 'risk'],
    ['A measure that reduces it, by making the cause less likely, its impact smaller, or both, is called a …',
      ['control'], 'control'],
    ['Risk is expressed as likelihood × …',
      ['impact'], 'impact']
  ];
  function norm(s) {
    s = s.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[.!]+$/, '').trim();
    s = s.replace(/^(a|an|the)\s+/, '');
    return s;
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w015-in').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('w015-right', 'w015-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w015-msg iw-msg';
  }
  QUESTIONS.forEach((q, i) => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w015-row';
    const lab = document.createElement('label');
    lab.className = 'w015-q'; lab.textContent = q[0]; lab.htmlFor = 'w015-in' + i;
    const inp = document.createElement('input');
    inp.className = 'w015-in'; inp.type = 'text'; inp.id = 'w015-in' + i;
    inp.autocomplete = 'off'; inp.spellcheck = false;
    inp.dataset.k = i;
    inp.addEventListener('input', clearMarks);
    row.appendChild(lab); row.appendChild(inp);
    rowsBox.appendChild(row);
  });
  root.querySelector('.w015-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, empty = 0;
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w015-in').forEach(inp => {
      inp.classList.remove('w015-right', 'w015-wrong');
      const v = norm(inp.value);
      if (!v) { empty++; return; }
      if (QUESTIONS[Number(inp.dataset.k)][1].indexOf(v) !== -1) { inp.classList.add('w015-right'); right++; }
      else { inp.classList.add('w015-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === QUESTIONS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct - name the threat, weigh the risk, choose the control.'; msg.className = 'w015-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (empty > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going - ' + empty + ' field(s) still empty.'; msg.className = 'w015-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - the red fields hold the wrong term.'; msg.className = 'w015-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w015-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w015-in').forEach(i => { i.value = ''; });
    clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w015-expl').hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w015-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearMarks();
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w015-in').forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = QUESTIONS[Number(inp.dataset.k)][2];
      inp.classList.add('w015-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w015-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w015-expl').hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
```
